services.name: Kids BJJ
services.desc: When it comes to training and fighting in a number of different martial arts, Coach Matt Pinkney is undoubtedly one of the best out there. Born and raised in West Philadelphia, this 37-year-old has been training and teaching for over a decade, having first learned Brazilian Jiu Jitsu before moving on to Muay Thai Kickboxing, boxing, and self defense. He has competed in over 20 amateur Muay Thai fights and has even had the honor of representing the United States at the World Championships held in Italy!
